_comment: Physical-verification toolchain pin (issue #4). Read by scripts/setup-env.sh, which installs klt at this exact commit into the checkout's .venv (never on the host) and fetches the klayout-tools fetch scripts at the same commit, sha256-checked.

klt.klt_required_commands is a CAPABILITY list, not a version number: `klt --version` reports klayout-tools' static pyproject.toml version, which can lag what commands an install actually has. Every layout/ runner should look each entry up in `klt --help` and fail loudly (exit 1, naming the missing command and the install fix) rather than skip a check silently. Keep one shared implementation of that check (conventionally layout/toolchain_pin.py) that every DRC/LVS/extraction runner imports.

This comment is APPEND-ONLY: record each later pin bump as a new paragraph naming the issue, what changed upstream, and why; a correction gets its own new paragraph, never an edit to the one it corrects.
Issue #4: first pin, klt at dce956c3c399; drc and lvs are the required commands (smoke evidence in layout/smoke/).

Issue #49: pin moved to the klayout-tools 0.8.0 release (tag v0.8.0, commit c572046be644). install_spec is now the PyPI release `klayout-tools==0.8.0`, because a git build reports a dev version that does not satisfy `==0.8.0` (klayout-tools#2823); setup-env.sh therefore checks `klt --version` against version_reported instead of a g<sha> suffix. fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh and fetch-ihp-sg13cmos5l.sh changed upstream (new sha256); _install_common.sh and fetch-sg13g2-sim-toolchain.sh are unchanged. Recorded evidence from the dce956c3c399 build is left as is.

klayout.note: klt pulls the klayout Python wheel itself; the curated drc/lvs engines need no klayout application. The PDK-native LVS runset (engine klayout-runset) needs the klayout application on PATH, which the host has at 0.28.16 (below the wheel); see layout/smoke/README.md.

klt_fetch_scripts._comment: Downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com/2AMLogic/klayout-tools/<commit>/scripts/<name>; a sha256 mismatch aborts setup.

smoke.source: libs.ref/sg13cmos5l_stdcell of the PDK pinned in sim/pdk.json
